[!git] skip
[!git-sha256] skip

env BOLERO_PRIVATE=vcs-test.golang.org

bolero mod tidy
stderr 'downloading vcs-test\.golang.org/go/mod/gitrepo-sha256 v1.3.0'

bolero run .
stdout '1234'

-- main.go --

	"fmt"

	sha256repo "vcs-test.golang.org/go/mod/gitrepo-sha256"

	fmt.Println(sha256repo.Foobar(1234))
}
